_about: In-context timing of the five string sections' Performance Legato as MuseScore plays slurs (2026-10-16, branch slur-rhythm, tools/soundlibraries/slur_rhythm/: score.py, events.py, run.cmd, heard.py, fit.py; their headers hold the rules). 243 slurs per section (first note 16th / eighth / quarter x 2-4 notes x 80 / 110 / 160 bpm x pp / mp / f x 3 pitches) x 2 takes (shuffles 16, 17), and a pitch sweep (sweep.py: every semitone of each section's range, an eighth + two sixteenths at 110 bpm, mp, 2 repeats x 2 takes, shuffles 21, 22), dumped by tst_liveequivalence dumpEvents (Recommended, even levels off), rendered per route with kthost + Kontakt 8 + SSO on the Windows test VM at CC11 127 (the patch's own level: the perceived envelope is not level-invariant). slurOnset: a slur's first note (smooth attack after silence) heard -15 dB under the slur's own top, less 30 ms, ms after its note-on: by pitch (the sweep; median: the sweep's), and the change by written length (lengthDms) and by dynamic (dynamicDms, MS4 CC1): the grid's medians of (heard - the sweep's onset at its pitch), less the sweep cell's (273 ms, CC1 64); byLength / byDynamic / byPitchIndex the grid's plain medians. glideAttack / glideSlur: the transition out of that first note / after a transition, by the note before's played length (ms), leave (glide.py phi 0.1) and arrive (heard: the first of 3 pYIN frames within 30 cents of the new pitch), medians per bin, n, IQR, phi9Arrive (glide.py's 9/10 crossing, the bendGlide definition) beside. rows: [kind, k, pitch, written ms, sent ms (- written), lenBefore, heardAfterOn, leave, glideArrive] (the grid's). gen_spitfire_sso.py writes slurOnset= (by pitch), slurOnsetLength=, slurOnsetDynamic=, bendGlideAttack=, bendGlideSlur=; the renderer reads them with [slurs] slurOnset / transitionModel.
